data.title: HRH the Crown Prince Holds Official Talks with Bulgarian Prime Minister in Riyadh
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- His Royal Highness Prince Mohammed bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud, Crown Prince and Prime Minister, received Prime Minister of the Republic of Bulgaria Rumen Radev in Riyadh on Sunday, where an official reception ceremony was held, followed by official talks.
    HRH the Crown Prince welcomed the Bulgarian prime minister to the Kingdom, and Radev expressed his pleasure at the visit and at meeting HRH the Crown Prince.
    The two sides reviewed bilateral relations, areas of cooperation, and opportunities to develop them across various sectors, and discussed recent regional and international developments and related efforts.
    Attending on the Saudi side were Deputy Governor of Riyadh Region Prince Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Abdulaziz; Minister of Foreign Affairs Prince Faisal bin Farhan bin Abdullah; Minister of State, Member of the Cabinet, and National Security Advisor Dr. Musaed Al-Aiban; Minister of Commerce Majid Al-Kassabi, the accompanying minister; Minister of Tourism Ahmed Al-Khateeb; Minister of Communications and Information Technology Abdullah Alswaha; Minister of Economy and Planning Faisal Alibrahim; and Saudi Ambassador to the Republic of Bulgaria Dr. Rami Al-Otaibi.
    The Bulgarian side included Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy, Investments and Industry Alexander Pulev; Minister of the Interior Ivan Demerdzhiev; Minister of Transport and Communications Georgi Peev; Minister of Innovation and Digital Transformation Ivan Vassilev; Minister of Tourism Ilin Dimitrov; and Bulgarian Ambassador to the Kingdom Lubomir Popov.
    -- SPA
16:41 Local Time 13:41 GMT
